future_decision_rules: Compare full raw F/B and common-scale crops; allow changed material objects and do not require identical pixel values or a single peak.

Track object/background separability, directional boundary readability, common replication/blur across separated objects, and spatial extent/persistence of row offsets. A new pit or localized scar alone is not a globally dirty tip.
C1/C2 apparent size and C3 edge shape are descriptive reference values with acknowledged row artifacts. Do not use arbitrary strict fractional-size or correlation pass thresholds.
Old BG1/BG2 remain N/A as quiet-background gates because they intersect present real edges. Do not silently move those old windows or use their roughness as proof of tip failure.
One shared rigid translation may assist feature correspondence; do not independently align each feature/direction to manufacture repeatability. Preserve original unaligned images.

An induction must first demonstrate task-relevant functional degradation in a complete frame before calling the next action repair. Absence of such degradation is an induction attempt, not a successful dirty→repair→usable cycle.
